reviews.title: 1 star: Would give zero if I could
reviews.text:
I opened CaseTracker to check one case. One. Here's how that went:

I got 1 second of actual content, followed by a 30-second ad. Then another ad for the thing the first ad was advertising. Then a pop-up begging me to "rate us 5 stars" (the irony). I aged visibly.

The ads can't be closed. The X button is a decorative suggestion, and the tiny close icon moves the moment your thumb gets near it. Tapping it takes you to the App Store to download a game about farming, or possibly gambling.

After using it, my phone started acting strange, with battery drain, random redirects, and permission requests that made no sense for a case-tracking app. I don't know what's running in the background, but it felt shady.

I came to track a case. Instead, the app tracked me, and my patience.

reviews.title: Used to Work, but No Longer Shows USCIS Updates
reviews.text:
My I-485 has already been approved, and the approval is clearly visible in my official USCIS online account. However, this app still does not show the approval or any corresponding update.

What makes this more frustrating is that case status updates used to work correctly in this app for some time, but recently they stopped working reliably. So this does not appear to be a limitation that was always there.

If the app can no longer reliably retrieve certain USCIS case updates without requiring users to log in, that limitation should be clearly disclosed. Immigration cases contain extremely sensitive personal information, so I am not comfortable providing USCIS account credentials to a third-party app just to get accurate case status.

A case tracker should be able to reflect major public case-status changes such as an I-485 approval without requiring access to a user’s USCIS account. Right now, that makes the app much less useful at the exact moment when accurate tracking matters most.

reviews.title: Advertisements vs. Website
reviews.text:
The app’s purpose is to serve as a convenient way of viewing/tracking USCIS & NVC statuses. The problem is every corner you take is full of ads now. You would be better off going to the official government website and making a Home Screen shortcut for the site and just pasting your case number there WITHOUT any ads and for free. The app is also hit or miss with updated information, on the app, 1 out of 2 applications I’ve submitted is marked completed, on the .gov website both applications I’ve submitted have been marked completed (which is correct).

It is hard to justify the ads when the only convenient thing about the app is that it retains the case/receipt # (which ppl can just take a screenshot and copy&paste on the .gov website easily), and somewhat poorly “tracks” the application process if you care about its history.

reviews.title: Worst app
reviews.text:
I remember this app being genuinely useful 5–6 years ago. Now, unless you pay, it is basically useless.

I have no idea whether the paid version is actually any better, because the premium price itself is ridiculous for an app that is mainly supposed to help you check your case status. 

Even worse, the case status in the free version is seriously outdated. So what exactly is the purpose of this app anymore?

I understand developers need to make money through subscriptions, premium features, or ads, but this has gone way too far. The free version feels deliberately crippled to force users into paying, while the premium subscription feels absurdly overpriced for what it provides.

Seriously, this feels like a money grab. You took an app that used to be useful and turned it into something frustrating, overpriced, and practically pointless unless users keep paying. If you continue treating users this way, people will simply delete the app and move on.

reviews.title: Used to be GREAT!
reviews.text:
I’ve used this app for years, and it worked wonderfully!  I paid they asked for it at the time, and it served me well for my family’s evolving situation.  

Then the developers, it seems, saw an opportunity in the panic some immigrants are feeling these days. The coaxing to pay too much for additional bells and whistles began at a drip that turned into a relentless torrent over time. The pressure campaign to “upgrade” to some expensive premium subscription now makes the  app very annoying to use. 

It drove me to find an alternative that was far more affordable, and actually worked better than this. Using both apps simultaneously, I found out that updates to cases were sometimes days late on here. The two cases I was tracking were approved days ago, and this apps was still not up to date when I deleted it yesterday.

reviews.title: Used to be Amazing, Now ruined by Ads
reviews.text:
I’ve had this app for 5 years to track all my cases, and honestly, until last year or maybe even 2 years ago, I would have rated this app 100/5. It was amazing. You could track your applications just by opening the app instead of constantly logging into your USCIS account, which saved a lot of time.

But since last year, or maybe the past 2 years, this app has become nothing but ads, extremely annoying long ads. As soon as you close the ads, there’s another constant pop-up asking you to upgrade to a paid account. On top of that, the status updates are at least 4–5 days behind the actual USCIS update date.

I’ve uninstalled the app and now just keep a Chrome tab open that’s logged into my USCIS account.

reviews.title: It was great in the past
reviews.text: I have been using this app from my very first case with USCIS and it was nice experience before. This year, app became a headache to use - 1) Super lagging updates on cases, at lease 3 days later than actual update happened. I mean why would I use it if it can not provide a handy and up-to-date update check?? 2) Too many Ads!! I understand the app needs to make profit and I’m not appreciate it. In the past, it’s a good amount to handle but now it is like every button triggers one and it takes long to pass. This is absolutely annoying and no help. I would suggest looking for other alternatives! Don’t waste your time and miss updates on the cases.

reviews.title: Improve transparency in case predictions
reviews.text:
The app is helpful for tracking basic case status, but the predictive data can be misleading. My estimated decision date shows July 2023, even though my case is still actively being processed and was last updated after that date. It also predicts “Case Received” as a next step, which already happened in 2023.

Additionally, the approval rate section is unclear and may confuse users about their real chances. For immigration cases, accuracy and clarity are extremely important. I recommend improving how predictions and statistics are explained.

reviews.title: It used to be great
reviews.text:
The app used to be great 2 years ago when it didn’t come with ads or fake push notifications about your case being updated just so that you open the app to keep seeing their ads. 2 years ago they weren’t shoving the subscription down your throat with a thousand ads, they were just offering the subscription IF you wanted to see more specifics about your case. Now it’s glitchy, has a million ads, sends you fake notifications and shows nothing different than just finding your own case from the USCIS website, which at the end of the day, it’s what you’ll have to do regardless, to check if your case was updated or not, because of these fake push notifications saying it was, when in fact, it wasn’t. 

The app used to be worth it, now it’s trash. If you want an app that helps you track your case better, I’d recommend Lawfully.

reviews.title: Do Not Download This App
reviews.text:
I have never written a review before but I feel morally compelled to in this instance. 

I am an immigration lawyer and used this app for several years to track hundreds of my cases. Previously, it worked well, and I could manually refresh all of my cases at anytime, and see accurate updates. I used the app so often I paid a onetime fee to permanently remove ads. 

Recently, however, the app hasn’t been working well at all. The manual refresh feature no longer works, and my cases simply update about once per week, all at the same time, and I can’t trust that I have accurate data. But what’s even more problematic and infuriating is that as of this week the app is absolutely covered in ads! I paid a fee to avoid ever seeing an ad again, and now not only are the ads back, which is fraud, they are so obstructive that the app is completely unusable! 

I will not watch a loud 30-second video of some loser talking about crypto just to get inaccurate case info! Absolutely repulsive, soulless, and greedy move on the part of the developers. 

Restore the old app, ad free for those of us who paid, within a week, or I’m deleting permanently.

reviews.title: Extremely ad heavy
reviews.text:
After the most recent update, this app became basically unusable. Ads pop up constantly… every few seconds there’s either a full-screen ad or a banner pushing you to pay for the app. It completely breaks the experience and makes it frustrating to do something as simple as check a case status.

I get that ads help generate revenue, and I’m fine with reasonable ads, but this is way over the top. When an app becomes this intrusive, what’s the point of using it at all? I ended up deleting it and switching to another case tracker because it was impossible to use comfortably anymore.

reviews.title: Payment Processing Error & Immediate Access Issue for Pro Subscription
reviews.text:
I initiated a purchase for the 3-month Pro subscription yesterday, totaling $25. Despite the payment being processed and deducted from my account, the application has consistently failed to recognize my paid status. Every time I attempt to access the Pro features, I am prompted to purchase the subscription again.

Due to this persistent error, I inadvertently attempted the purchase a second time, resulting in a duplicate charge for the $25 Pro subscription. I have now paid $50 in total, but I still cannot access the features I have paid for, as the application continues to demand payment.

reviews.title: Helpful, but the ads are taking over.
reviews.text: I use this app to track my family cases. However, recently the app had been lagging a lot. Ads show up constantly to where I can’t view the cases anymore. I have to close and reopen a couple times for the ads to go away. Almost seems like any ads can be on there, even the ones you can’t x out of unless you restart the app. I know paying for subscription seems ideal but not for 1 or 2 cases. I don’t mind seeing ads here and there since I am not paying for a subscription, but these ads are taking over the app. It’s almost like your phone is getting a virus attack. Hopefully this can be fixed soon.
